newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's PSI-20 index up 3 pct in 3 days.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's PSI-20 index up 3 pct in 3 days.

text.p: Portugal's PSI20 index of 20 leading shares rose three percent over the past three days on heavy buying by national investment funds confident about the progress of the Portuguese economy, dealers said.
"Today's rise seems to me to be exaggerated," said one operator. "There are many investment funds, mainly domestic, which have a lot of money and are buying with force."
The PSI-20 index rose 2.05 percent to 5,307.42 today and hit an all-time high of 5,308.36.
Another operator said: "On Friday Spain rose more than two percent and we rose less than one percent. I don't see any reasons why we should not rise as much as Spain."
However, he added: "A correction of prices is imminent."

Analysts contacted by Reuters forecast that Lisbon bourse could rise by up to 20 percent this year compared with 1996 because of the healthy economy, an aggressive privatisation programme and cheap shares relative to other markets.
The PSI20 index rose by some 32 percent in 1996.
